text: # T7 transfer review The total T7 charge is 120 credits. The ledger lists A as 60, B as 40 and C as 20 credits; adding those lines gives 120 credits. Charge A breaches the individual-charge cap. Policy P2 sets the cap at 50 credits, and the ledger records A as 60 credits. The physical receipt occurred at 16:40 local time on 4 November 2026. The physical receipt scan records that timestamp for T7. The physical receipt missed the policy P3 deadline. Policy P3 sets the receipt deadline at 16:30; the receipt scan records 16:40. The supplied records do not establish T7 release eligibility. Policy P4 requires quality and security approvals; the ledger records quality approval but supplies no security status, and the receipt records arrival only. This does not establish that security approval never occurred. Charge B is 40 credits. The supplied package provides no grading criterion for calling the handover exemplary. Policy P5 expressly states that no such definition or scale is supplied; no exemplary grade is inferred.
